packages.name: Hudson Taylor: A Retrospect
packages.description: Hudson Taylor's autobiographical account of his calling and life work in China as founder of the China Inland Mission. All twenty chapters of LibriVox's public-domain recording of A Retrospect.
packages.author: LibriVox

packages.name: Amy Carmichael: From Sunrise Land
packages.description: Letters from Amy Carmichael's early missionary work in Japan before she settled in India. LibriVox's public-domain recording of From Sunrise Land, read by Expatriate.
packages.author: LibriVox

packages.name: Amy Carmichael: Lotus Buds
packages.description: Amy Carmichael's account of her work among the girls of India at Dohnavur, the "Lotus Buds." LibriVox's public-domain recording of Lotus Buds.
packages.author: LibriVox

packages.name: Saint Francis of Assisi: A Biography
packages.description: Johannes Jorgensen's classic biography of Francis of Assisi, from conversion through the founding of the Franciscan Order to the stigmata and his death. LibriVox's CC0 recording, read by Dave7.
packages.author: LibriVox

packages.name: The Life of Saint Paul
packages.description: A short biography of Saint Paul, the Apostle of the Gentiles, from persecutor to missionary to martyr. LibriVox's public-domain recording of Frances Alice Forbes's biography.
packages.author: LibriVox

packages.name: The Biography of Robert Murray McCheyne
packages.description: Andrew Bonar's biography of Robert Murray McCheyne, Scottish minister and missionary to Palestine and the Jews. LibriVox's public-domain recording, read by Douglas Allen.
packages.author: LibriVox

packages.name: The Life of Rev. Henry Martyn
packages.description: John Hall's biography of Henry Martyn, Church of England missionary to India and Persia and Bible translator. LibriVox's public-domain recording, read by Hannah Mary.
packages.author: LibriVox

packages.name: Raymond Lull: First Missionary to the Moslems
packages.description: Samuel Zwemer's biography of Raymond Lull, medieval Franciscan philosopher and missionary to North Africa who died a martyr. LibriVox's public-domain recording, read by AletheiaCharis.
packages.author: LibriVox
